whyItMatters: Without a resolved version Poetry's install is keyed on whatever the environment resolves, so the lockfile stops being a record of what was audited and no version-based check can read the install at all.
actions: Re-run `poetry lock --no-update` and commit the regenerated `poetry.lock`, so every `[[package]]` block records the version Poetry resolved.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm poetry.lock no longer carries a locked package that records no version.
